pages.name: Sicilian: Loewenthal, 5...a6
pages.notes: Overview and plans described a weak d6-pawn when the line is 6.Nd6+ Bxd6 7.Qxd6, giving White the bishop pair; plan 2 played ...b5 into the knight. Rewrote plans 1-3. Overview fixed in the follow-up in batch 2026-11-16-15 (reviewer: first draft had White's trade weakening White's dark squares).
